name: io.github.CompanyFramework/connector
title: Company Framework
description: Kits, books and free AI bots for contractors: site search, bots as prompts, kit setup help.

tools.name: search_company_framework
tools.description: Searches companyframework.com: the kits, the books, prices, license, refunds, the free tools, the field notes and the Fathomed bots, plus answer pages on job costing, contractor profit and sales commission. Returns matching passages with their source URLs.

query.description: The question or words to look for.

tools.name: list_fathomed_bots
tools.description: Lists the Fathomed bots, free AI assistants for the trades (estimators, follow-up writers, collectors and more), with each one's slug, trade, release date, Grok link and plain-text instructions URL. Takes an optional filter word, such as a trade.

filter.description: Optional word to filter on, such as fence, roofing or collections.

tools.name: get_fathomed_bot
tools.description: Returns the full written instructions of one Fathomed bot, given its slug.

slug.description: The bot's slug, for example fence-estimator.

tools.name: kit_contents
tools.description: Returns the file-by-file contents of a Company Framework kit, as the kit page lists it. Kits: The Job Cost Standard, The Production Standard, The Appointment Standard, The Commission Standard, The Complete Standard.

kit.description: The kit's name, for example Job Cost or Commission.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Returns what Company Framework has released recently: Fathomed bots by release date, newest first.

days.description: How far back to look, in days. Default 30.

tools.name: buyer_setup_help
tools.description: Returns passages from the kit and book documents a buyer owns, for setup and how-to questions, with the list of files in their order. Requires the order: the download link from the purchase receipt, which contains session_id=cs_. The order is verified as paid with Stripe on each call and only the kits it includes are searched.

order.description: The download link from their receipt, or the cs_ order id in it.

tools.name: request_a_bot
tools.description: Sends a request for a new Fathomed bot to Company Framework: what the bot should do and for which trade, with an optional email for word when it ships. Requests are read weekly; one requested bot can ship each week.

idea.description: What the bot should do, in a sentence or two.

trade.description: The trade or kind of business.

email.description: Optional. Where to say it shipped.

tools.name: ask_jd
tools.description: Sends a question to JD Davenport, who wrote the Company Framework method. Includes an optional email address, which is the only way a reply can be sent.

question.description: The question, in the person's words.

email.description: Where JD should reply. Optional, but without it there is no reply.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches companyframework.com and returns result ids, titles and URLs, in the shape that ChatGPT connectors and deep research use.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full text, title and URL of one result, given its id.
